title: carex atrata subsp. longistolonifera
intro: Carex atrata subsp. longistolonifera, commonly known as the Alpine Sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. The Alpine Sedge is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a sought-after herbal remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of the Alpine Sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
